notes.title: New direction, new goals
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We previously shared a roadmap for the upcoming version 1.4 of the game. However, after several meetings, we decided to change our plans. As we progressed through the different tasks, several observations emerged:

 The game's identity was not distinct enough.
 The visual aspect of the game, both in terms of effects and UI, could be improved.
 The dynamics of matches could be enhanced to increase immersion and maximize the enjoyment of each game.

We initially did everything to bring the game to a level we were satisfied with at launch, but now we want more. We want to push the quality, immersion, and accessibility of various aspects of the game even further.
To achieve our goals, we had to make a decision: continue introducing elements one by one as originally planned, risking constant back-and-forth adjustments with every new change, or work deeply on every aspect of the game and deliver the entire overhaul in one major update.
We chose the second option. This will allow us to better control each new or modified aspect of the game and ensure that all additions integrate seamlessly, resulting in a cohesive experience across all levels. This way, no element will feel neglected or fall short of the quality standard we now aim to reach.

As a reminder, we are a very small team, this is our first game, and every step forward, every addition, is a new learning experience for us. That’s why implementing all the changes we envision will take time. We also need to revisit the code, fix existing issues, and make the game more robust and easier to work with for future updates.
But rest assured! The goals we shared in the previous roadmap remain unchanged and will still be included. However, we are going further—reworking every aspect of the game while keeping the core intact. Instead of aiming for version 1.4, we are now targeting 2.0. These may just be numbers for you, but for us, they represent a real leap between the game's current state and its future.

As you might expect, it will be difficult for us to share an exact release date for this update. However, we are doing everything we can to release it this year, in 2025.
Here are the different improvements and features planned for version 2.0:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881362/c3da2e222f5c63b28bf335b7b95c1087dfef151e.png

We will communicate updates on this version as soon as we have concrete progress to share.
In the meantime, you can find Waiju on his stream, where he shares ongoing developments. You’ll be able to ask any questions you have and get an exclusive look at the upcoming features we are working on.
If you have any suggestions or questions about the game, feel free to share them with us on our Discord

A huge thank you to all the players who continue to enjoy our game! <3 We hope that the future we are preparing for the game will excite you!

Please be patient,
The Waiju Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Following update 1.3, some bugs crept into the code. I did my best to correct them, here is the list:

- [Fix] During a team game and when selecting magic, the player whose turn it was not cannot navigate through the magic proposal. This is now fixed.
- [Fix] During a game in free positioning and when selecting magic, if the player whose turn it was not to play selected his magic then he found himself in aiming mode without power get out. This is now fixed.
- [Fix] After a game, certain settings were not replicated correctly to other players in the lobby. This is now fixed
- [Fix] When accepting an invitation, players who had not completed the tutorial and refused to do so when the validation window appeared found themselves stuck in an infinite loading screen. This is now fixed. There is still a small problem which will systematically display the tutorial confirmation window if a player accepts an invitation when the game is not open. We are currently working to correct this behavior.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Game customization
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since we last gave any news, but rest assured, we've been very active behind the scenes! We've used this time to bring you a big update, access to game customization and the addition of new features. You can now play Power Of Pétanque as you wish!

Here's more detail on what you can find in this update:

Lobby
- [Addition] New game customization options:
 Number of balls: Choose precisely the number of balls per player.
 Quantity of life points: Choose precisely the number of life points per player.
 Time per turn: Set the time limit per turn. You can also decide to have as much time as you want.
 Time for magic selection: Set the time limit to select your magic. You can also decide to have as much time as you want.
 Enable/Disable magic: Decide if you want to play with or without magic.
 Frequency of obtaining magic: Decide if you want to receive a magic proposal when you play several times in a row or not.
 Free positioning: Allow players to throw their balls from an area rather than a fixed position.
 Choice of magic: Define precisely which magics will be available in your game.
 Avoid duplicates: Choose whether magic suggestions can offer duplicates or not (depending on the number of activated magics, it is possible that duplicates still appear)


In-game
- [Added] If you have enabled the free positioning option in the game settings, players will be able to throw their balls from an area extending along their side of the playground.
- [Added] With the TAB key (default) you can now display, in addition to the ranking, above the players their number of balls and life points as well as the ranking of the three balls closest to the cochonnet. The number of balls and life points can be permanently displayed from the game options.
- [Fix] Fixed a bug where players could see their hat in first-person view.
- [Fix] Fixed a bug preventing the player from canceling their target if they manage to validate their shot outside the playground.
- [Fix] At the end of a turn it was possible to remain stuck in targeted mode without being able to exit it if the player did not throw their ball in time. This is now fixed.
- [Fix] In teams, we have fixed the interface to more clearly display the magic possessed by your partner.
- [Fix] The key to switch to strategic view was not displayed when it was not your turn to play. This is now fixed.

Magic
- [Added] New magic: Dash. When in contact with the ground, your ball will launch towards the cochonnet. Use this power to counter obstacles deployed by your opponents.
- [Modification] The magic Shield will now prevent Teleportation in addition to blocking elimination.
- [Fixed] Fixed a bug that could accelerate balls infinitely when they pass through the Swamp.
- [Fixed] In some cases, when destroyed, the Rock Python could eliminate the ball placed on it. This has been fixed.

Customization
- [Added] New set! Including a hat, armor and boots.
- [Added] 2 new beards.
- [Added] 4 new ball patterns.
- [Modified] New model for the Messy beard, which needed a refresh.

Tutorial
- [Added] When the game is first launched, when clicking on the play button, a confirmation window has been added to launch the tutorial. The game will no longer force you into the tutorial ;)
- [Fixed] Fixed a bug where the menu music continued to play in the tutorial.

Hope you like the content of this update. Have fun!

If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, please let us know on our Discord or on discussion forums.

Waiju

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Shoot & Point
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's what you can find in this update:

Throw mode
- [Added] New throwing mode: Point! With its bell curve, this shooting mode should allow you to get behind the obstacles left by your opponents. Nothing can stop you.
- [Modification] New interface for throwing modes. We have reworked the throw mode interface to make it quicker to identify which fire mode you are using. It is also much prettier(in our opinion).
- [Modification] Renamed throwing modes. Direct becomes Shoot and Curved becomes Normal.

In game
- [Modification] Reduced ball bounce. The balls should behave more logically on gravel and grass, no need to ignore these two terrains.
- [Fix] Fixed display of team partner information. The activation button for your magic was displayed over your partner's magic, this is no longer the case.
- [Fix] There could be a difference between clients and the server in the distances displayed in strategic view. This could lead to misunderstandings. The server is now responsible for giving the correct distance to all clients. No more debates.
- [Fix] Fixed a bug where the incorrect target validation sound could be played while the player was not in aim mode.
- [Fix] Fixed a bug where the priming sound would play in a loop at the end of a player's turn.
- [Added] Added the inverted mouse option in the key options.

Magic
- [Modification] Force Field magic changes from tier 1 to tier 2. It will therefore be rarer than before. No more Berlin Walls.
 - [Modification/Correction] Balls could get stuck bouncing infinitely against the Force field. Now if this happens the force field will expel the stuck balls gradually stronger.
- [Fix] Sometimes the Gust could not expel the Cochonnet. This should be fixed, however as the bug is very complicated to resolve it may not be resolved 100%. If this is the case please let us know.

Lobby
- [Added] In teams, added text when players hover to indicate that it is possible to swap places. This feature was already present but often unknown to players because it was not highlighted enough.
- [Modification] Now all players can invite their friends to a lobby and not just the host.

Personalization
- [Added] Now notifications will tell you if new customization elements have been added. This way you can always be on top of style.

Tutorial
- [Modification] Changed certain texts in the tutorial because they were considered too long or not explicit enough.
- [Fix] Some "Hold to pass" texts were not displayed.
- [Fix] Crashes could occur during the tutorial. This should be resolved.


If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please let us know on our Discord or on discussion forums.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Tutorial and Training
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is an update mainly focused on the tutorial as well as the training mode.
Below you will find a list of additions and modifications:

- [Added] New playable tutorial
- [Added] Training mode
- [Added] Added text in the lobby to mention that all players must be ready to start the game.
- [Modification] Holding the left click while launching is no longer needed, only during arming
- [Modification] Removed ball selection in strategic view, you can now hover over balls to see their information
- [Modifications] Ready player indicator in the lobby made more visible

Thank you again for playing Power of Pétanque and thank you for your comments and suggestions.
Stay tuned for future updates which will be focused on gameplay and game content.

notes.title: Hotfix 3 - Minor issues
notes.content:
Hello everybody, we are working hard to make the game even better. While we are working on new things to add to the game, here is a little hotfix :

- Added a key to hide/display the magic proposal when selecting. It will allow you to see the playground and chose a magic accordingly of the situation.
- Fixed a bug where the timer sound will trigger at the start of your turn.
- Added a security if a ball fall under the ground (it will be teleported back on the playground)
- Added a security on the force field magic. Sometimes balls were able to enter the force field.

Thanks again for buying and playing Power of Petanque !
